page.layout: One scan: the front board of a bound volume, blind-tooled pigskin or calf with a decorative panelled border, two green metal clasp fittings on the left edge, and raised bands on the spine at the right. No printed text.
page.notes: Front cover of the binding, not a printed page. Blind-tooled decorative frame with ornamental rolls and a central rectangular panel; two green metal clasp plates on the fore-edge. A ruler or scale strip appears at the upper right, outside the book, and is not transcribed. No printed text on this scan.
